verdict.rationale: Glama is a platform with an API, so an OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair thing to ask for, but the evidence shows none: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The connector.json schema describes a connector config file, not the API, and llms.txt is a directory summary rather than an API spec, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
